rawValueRestrictions.color: no raw hex/rgb/hsl colour anywhere in a PageSpec; reference a color.* token
rawValueRestrictions.spacing: no raw px/rem/vw lengths; spacing is owned by section contracts (sheet padding 40px, 20px at 768px and below)
rawValueRestrictions.fontFamily: only font.family.* tokens (serif = heading face, sans = body face, stix = italic accent face); no other font
rawValueRestrictions.fontSize: type sizes are owned by section contracts and switch at 990px and 768px (see responsive values)

unsupportedFontsNote: Georgia is only the fallback behind the heading face; no other family is used by the clone, so a generated page may not choose any of these directly. The heading, body and italic faces are font.family.serif / sans / stix.

surface.note: The only per-instance token override a PageSpec node can carry: the section's background surface, restricted to the surfaces that section really renders in the clone.

overrides: PageSpec nodes carry no other style/token overrides; typography, spacing, radius and elevation are owned by the section contracts. Scheme colours (product pages) are chosen through the node variant, not through style.
